basic_info.description: The height of Bernal Heights Living!  Meticulously designer-renovated 3BR/2BA house with HUGE flat garden with free-standing office.  Chef's kitchen, lux baths, & endless thoughtful details. Extremely rare, flat lot -- 126' deep -- creates truly exceptional outdoor living. Walk to Holly Park & St Mary's Park!  One car garage + Driveway & street parking.
